info.title: LexFlow API
info.summary: Case records, reference data and document storage for LexFlow.
info.description: Phase 1 API. **There is no authentication yet**: run it on 127.0.0.1 only and never expose it to a network. Sample records are fictional and are marked with `isSample`.

get.description: Report whether the API is up and can reach PostgreSQL.

post.description:
Sign in with e-mail and password. Sets the session cookie.

Every refusal is the same 401 ``invalid-credentials``, whatever the reason.
End the current session (if any) and clear the cookie. Always 204.

get.description: Who is signed in. 401 ``not-authenticated`` without a live session.

post.description: Replace your own password (also a temporary one). Ends your other sessions.

get.description:
Clients with their contact details, by name.

Administrators see every client; Advocates and Paralegals only the clients
of cases they may see.

schema.title: Response List Clients Api Clients Get

post.description: Add a client (Administrators and Advocates).

get.description:
Every client, by name, without contact details: the new-case form's choices.

For those who may open cases (Administrators and Advocates).

schema.title: Response Client Options Api Clients Options Get

get.description: Active Advocates and Paralegals, by name: who can join a case team.

schema.title: Response List Staff Api Staff Get

get.description: Active users who can lead a case (role Advocate), by name.

schema.title: Response List Advocates Api Advocates Get

get.description:
A client's details and the cases of theirs you may see.

404 for a client none of whose cases you may see (Administrators see all).

patch.description: Change a client's details (an Administrator, or an Advocate on one of their cases).

get.description: The cases you may see (all, for an Administrator), newest first.

parameters.name: archived

schema.description: Archived cases: leave out (default), include, or only.
schema.title: Archived

parameters.description: Archived cases: leave out (default), include, or only.

schema.title: Response List Cases Api Cases Get

post.description:
Open a new case. The server assigns the case number and opening date.

Administrators and Advocates only; an Advocate must be the lead (403
``field-not-permitted`` otherwise).

get.description:
One case with its documents, hearings, timeline and your permissions on it.

A case you may not see answers 404, exactly like one that does not exist.

patch.description:
Change some of a case's details. Any change adds a timeline entry by you.

Each field needs its own permission (``permissions.editableFields`` in the
case detail); one refused field (403 ``field-not-permitted``) refuses the
whole request, so nothing changes. Changing the lead advocate or the client
is for Administrators only.

post.description: Archive a case (Administrators): kept in full, read-only, hidden from lists.
Restore an archived case (Administrators).

Add an Advocate (as associate) or a Paralegal to the case team.

The Administrator or the case's lead advocate only.

delete.description: Take someone off the case team (the Administrator or the lead advocate).

get.description: Hearings on or after today on the cases you may see, soonest first.

schema.title: Response Upcoming Hearings Api Hearings Upcoming Get

get.description: The documents on a case, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api Cases  Case Id  Documents Get

post.description:
Attach one file to a case.

The file's real content must match its extension. Errors carry a ``code``:
``unsupported-type``, ``content-mismatch``, ``empty``, ``duplicate``,
``too-large`` or ``invalid-name``.

file.description: One file: PDF, Word, text, PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP.

get.description:
One page (or part) of a document's extracted text (staff on the case).

409 ``text-not-available`` (with the reason) until the text is ready;
404 for deleted documents, documents on cases you may not see, and pages
that do not exist. Each read is recorded in the audit log.

parameters.name: section

schema.description: The page (PDF) or part to read.
schema.title: Section

parameters.description: The page (PDF) or part to read.

post.description:
Extract a document's text again: after a failure, or to refresh it.

For staff who may add documents to the case; not on archived cases.
409 while it is already waiting or being processed, or for file types that
are not extracted.

get.description: Download a stored file. Sample records have no file and return 404 ``no-file``.

delete.description:
Delete a document (Administrator or the lead advocate).

The document leaves the case but is kept, with its file, until restored or
purged by an operator (``python -m lexflow.cli.documents purge``).

post.description:
Share a document with the case's client: it appears in their portal.

Advocates on the case (and Administrators). Sample records cannot be
shared (422 ``no-file``). Sharing it again changes nothing.
Stop sharing a document with the client (it leaves their portal at once).

get.description: A case's deleted documents, most recently deleted first (Administrator or lead).

schema.title: Response List Deleted Documents Api Cases  Case Id  Documents Deleted Get

post.description:
Put a deleted document back on its case (Administrator or the lead advocate).

409 ``duplicate`` while another document on the case has the same name.
Restoring a document that is not deleted changes nothing.

get.description:
Passages of this case's documents that match the query, best first.

For staff who may view the case. Results come only from the case's own
documents (not deleted, text extracted) and show where each passage is.
They are ranked text, not legal advice or a prediction.
Totals, courts and years in the collection, and which search modes work.
The collection, newest decision first (undated last), with stable paging.

Judgments ranked by their best passage for the query (at most 100), paged.

409 ``semantic-search-unavailable`` (with the reason) for semantic or
hybrid search when embeddings cannot run; keyword search always works.
One judgment with its source and the terms-of-use record of that source.
One page (or part) of a judgment's text, exactly as extracted.

parameters.name: section

schema.description: The page (PDF) or part to read.
schema.title: Section

parameters.description: The page (PDF) or part to read.

get.description:
Hearings across the cases you may see, in a date range, soonest first.

Archived cases are left out; cancelled hearings only when asked for. The
range may span at most a year.

parameters.name: to

schema.description: Last day (default: 30 days after the first).
schema.title: To

parameters.description: Last day (default: 30 days after the first).

post.description: Schedule a hearing on a case. The date cannot be in the past.

patch.description: Change a scheduled hearing. 409 ``hearing-cancelled`` once it is cancelled.

post.description: Cancel a hearing. It stays on the case, with the reason if one is given.

get.description:
The audit log, newest first, filtered and a page at a time (read-only).

Append-only in the database, but not tamper-proof against someone with
database administrator rights.

parameters.name: action

schema.description: An action, or a prefix ending in a dot (``document.``).
schema.title: Action

parameters.description: An action, or a prefix ending in a dot (``document.``).

get.description: Every account, by role and name.

schema.title: Response List Users Api Admin Users Get

post.description:
Create an account with a temporary password (replaced at first sign-in).

The password is never returned. Client accounts need ``clientId``.

patch.description: Change an account's name or e-mail address.

post.description:
Stop an account from signing in and end its sessions.

409 for your own account or the last active Administrator.
Allow a disabled account to sign in again.
Clear a lockout after repeated failed sign-ins.

Give an account a temporary password: their sessions end, and they must
choose a new password at the next sign-in. Not for your own account (409).

get.description: Your cases (archived ones are not shown), newest first.

schema.title: Response List Cases Api Portal Cases Get

get.description: One of your cases, with its coming hearings and the documents shared with you.
Download a document shared with you. Anything else answers 404.
